sloka: न स्म विभ्राजते देवी शोकाश्रुलुलितानना ।ते च दृष्ट्वा तथा सुप्ते शुभे देव्यौ च तम् नृपम् ॥२-६५-१९॥
transliteration: na sma vibhrājate devī śokāśrululitānanā ।te ca dṛṣṭvā tathā supte śubhe devyau ca tam nṛpam ॥2-65-19॥

translations.english: Having seen the two auspicious queens asleep, the women in the inner apartment thought the king died in his sleep.
